summary: Diginex Limited filed Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CEO Lubomila Jordanova effective August 31, 2026, due to personal reasons, not disagreements. Jordanova was engaged as Senior Advisor to the Board through Rippling Switzerland GmbH from September 1, 2026, to February 28, 2027, at an annual salary of CHF 321,559.80. Board member Tomicah Tillemann-Dick resigned September 3, 2026, also for personal reasons. Archana Kotecha was appointed interim CEO and Graham Bridges CTO effective August 31, 2026. COO Jacob S. Friedman resigned effective September 30, 2026. Watch for further leadership stabilization and strategic direction.
